description:
Zomi Language Portal is the home of the Zomi language on your phone — an AI-powered translator built with the Zomi community, for the Zomi community.

TRANSLATE INSTANTLY
• Translate between English and Zomi with streaming, real-time results
• A confidence indicator and a blue Official badge on every verified translation
• Seven language registers, from everyday conversation to songs, journalism, theology, and poetry

HEAR THE LANGUAGE
• Tap the speaker to hear Zomi words and phrases pronounced aloud
• Built-in pronunciation guide for Zomi sounds

LEARN AND REMEMBER
• Build your own glossary of Zomi words and phrases
• Every translation is saved to your history — searchable and organized
• Translation tips help you get the best results

YOUR ACCOUNT, EVERYWHERE
• Sign in with Google or Apple
• Your glossary and saved translations sync securely across all your devices
• Join a community of Zomi speakers and learners, with verified contributors recognized with a blue badge

Zomi Language Portal is made for the Zomi diaspora worldwide — keep the language alive, wherever you are.

Support: https://zomi.me/contact
